source_refs.note: Topic 2.2.1.4 Input and Output Operations (PDF 36-37, printed 33-34). MCQ 4 is answered.

blocks.text: Input and output operations allow you to interact with the user. You can ask the user to enter data (input) and display information to the user (output).

items: Input: Use the input () function to get user input. The input () function displays a message on the screen and waits for the user to type something and press Enter. The text entered by the user is then stored in a variable. For example:

blocks.text: This line of code asks the user to enter their name and stores it in the variable name.

items: Output: Use the print () function to display information on the screen. The print () function takes one or more arguments and displays them. For example:

blocks.text: This line of code displays a greeting message that includes the user's name.
